# HaruMusic 0.1.9

- Stream media continuously through the on-device gateway on Android and desktop instead of buffering a full range block before responding. Preserve source headers, byte ranges, cancellation and backpressure. No external public proxy is required by this transport.
- Start playback at the first decoded audio frame. Desktop media probes stop after audio headers instead of reading a complete file from CDNs that ignore Range.
- Fix normal mobile lyrics accidentally being flex-centered outside their scrolling viewport. Restore current-line focus, translation and complete wrapping. Use stable line metrics, interruptible spring scrolling and audio-clock paint updates for both lyric modes.
- Close auxiliary windows and active HTTP work during Windows update installation. The installer closes only the executable at its destination installation path, including its helper process tree.

Validation: 141 unit tests, TypeScript, embedded API streaming/cancellation checks and mobile viewport automation. Real-device public source playback and end-to-end replacement of an already installed desktop app remain separate acceptance checks; source catalog and account restrictions still apply.
